description: This file defines the 'Analytics' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which acts as a plugin for handling JSONRPC communication related to analytics. It declares interface implementations, private members, and methods relevant to plugin initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: A plugin class implementing a JSONRPC server for analytics, handling initialization, deinitialization, and notifications.
